en: I'd love a Skitty. I'd swap my Meowth for one. Would you?
text: Mi-ar plăcea un Skitty. Mi-aș schimba Meowth-ul pe unul. Ai vrea?

en: A Skitty! How lovely. Meowow is a bit of a snob, but a dear.
text: Un Skitty! Ce frumos. Meowow e puțin snob, dar scump.

en: That isn't a Skitty. It's a Skitty I'm longing for.
text: Ăsta nu e un Skitty. Eu tânjesc după un Skitty.

en: Oh. If you find a Skitty, please remember me.
text: Oh. Dacă găsești un Skitty, te rog să-ți amintești de mine.

en: Skitty has charmed the whole lounge. I hope Meowow is just as charming.
text: Skitty a vrăjit tot salonul. Sper că Meowow e la fel de fermecător.
